nuggets.text: Dan Campbell spent 2016 to 2020 in New Orleans as the Saints' assistant head coach and tight ends coach.
At his first press conference as Lions coach in 2021, Dan Campbell promised his team would "bite a kneecap off."
The Lions began as the Portsmouth Spartans and took their name in 1934 as a nod to baseball's Detroit Tigers.
The Lions' Honolulu blue is inspired by the color of the waves off the coast of Hawaii.
The Lions have played on Thanksgiving every year since 1934, except for 1939 to 1944 during World War II.
Ford Field is built around a 1920s Hudson's warehouse, which holds most of the stadium's premium suites.
Amon-Ra St. Brown's father, John Brown, was a bodybuilder and a two-time amateur Mr. Universe.
Lions kicker Jake Bates' first in-game field goal ever was a 64-yarder in the UFL in 2024.
Jahmyr Gibbs, nicknamed "Sonic," set the Lions' single-season record with 20 touchdowns in 2024.
Penei Sewell, born in American Samoa, was the youngest player ever to start at left tackle in an NFL game.
